summary: Re-verified the two previously-flagged web regressions on explore.web.tsx. Both PASS. (A) `header-location-pill` renders in the Explore header at mobile viewport (375x667) on http://localhost:3000/(tabs)/explore with 'Hi, there' kicker + 'Jaipur (default)' title + chevron-down; tapping it routes to /location-picker (verified navigation + location-picker screen rendered). (B) After clicking a property pin (e.g. ₹2.20 Cr), the sheet header switches to the `pin-preview-back` 'Back to listings' pill with brandTertiary background (rgb(234,227,217)), minHeight 44px, borderRadius 999px (pill), and large hitSlop; clicking it returns the sheet header to the properties count + view-toggle row (view-toggle-map re-appears).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both testIDs confirmed present and functional on explore.web.tsx at mobile viewport: (1) [data-testid=header-location-pill] -> /location-picker (verified screen rendered with Set your location, Jaipur (default) · Active). No regressions.
